comment: Known advisories, production and dev, signed off with a review deadline. scripts/audit-gate.mjs fails CI on any high/critical advisory missing here, on any entry audit no longer reports, and on a critical entry past reviewBy. `reviewBy: null` means informational only (moderate/low) — no deadline, never gating.

advisories.reason: No patched release exists at any version, so there is nothing to upgrade to; npm can only offer a semver-major downgrade of jest. Reachable only through jest's devDependency tree (jest-config → deepmerge), never in a shipped build. Re-check when jest next takes a major.
